title: Fully normalized coordinate counit specification
statement: Use [def-sp-chart-tate-tower-data], [def-sp-tower-p1-adjunction-data], [def-sp-coordinate-adjunction-categories], [def-sp-coordinate-tate-tensor-comparisons], [def-sp-coordinate-right-comparisons], [def-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-interfaces], [def-amb-affine-trace-tower], [def-sp-ell-twist-quotient-data], [def-sp-tower-class-pullback], [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal]. Fix the coefficient prime and extension, a field k, a coefficient-tower base, canonical operations and section-normalized coordinates, finite coordinates, preservation and its canonical calculus, and a specified normalized Tate-tower family. Define Construction to be the existing dependent existential specification of normalized coordinate adjunction data: projective presentations and their fixed AdjunctionData; finite root-projection-normalized Kummer identifications; total-complex tensor-shift isomorphisms; ordinary pure-tensor and K-flat-normalized Tate products; root-section and coefficient-normalized pullbacks; the affine restriction with its ordinary root formula; the requisite full domains; projection pairs and ordered-right identifications. The affine Hom map must be exactly the P1 Hom map followed by the exact open Hom map and the normalized affine comparison. Its successors satisfy CompositeEquation with the canonical compact-support compositor and the specified stepComponent. The zero projection transports the identity using the section-normalized identity pullback, coefficient unit and shift zero. The chart pairs and all finite comparisons retain their specified left and right evaluation arrows and both adjunction compatibility equations. Finally the chart counit is exactly inverse normalized right comparison, inverse canonical compact-support compositor, compact support of the etale sum counit under the specified etale-shriek comparison, then the projection counit. This defines a proposition, not an assertion of its truth; none of its equations is omitted.
